why: No major reviewer compares 300W desktop stations head to head, but two answer it in part with testing: Macworld names a tested 300W desktop pick with its measured port hierarchy and price, and Notebookcheck has a full tested review of the exact 8-port 300W unit the query targets. Tom's Hardware is a general charger guide and does not reach 300W. The rest are brand blogs (UGREEN, Titan), launch news, one niche comparison with unverifiable testing, and affiliate listicles. A focused multi-station comparison with live prices and codes could get in and would fill the comparison gap, but it would compete with Macworld and Notebookcheck for the citation.
